traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Philydraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear or lanceolate; stipules absent; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers in spikes; flowers zygomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule or berry; stamens 1; carpels 3. traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Philydraceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded often a rhizome, often a corm.
